free_tier.stated: Network volumes are paid storage with no free allowance: standard storage is $0.07/GB/month for the first 1 TB and $0.05/GB/month beyond 1 TB; high-performance storage is $0.14/GB/month.

egress.terms: When your account balance reaches $0, Pods with an attached network volume are stopped and storage charges continue to accrue; if the charges cannot be covered the volume may eventually be terminated and its data cannot be recovered.
